mapper.select: SELECT sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM juso_sigungu sgg JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE ST_Contains( sgg.sgg_border, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM juso_sigungu sgg JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE ST_Contains( sgg.sgg_border, #{point} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coord_poi ( coord_point_name, coord_point_point, coord_point_type, first_reg_dt, last_mod_dt, sgg_id ) VALUES ( #{coordinatePointName}, #{coordinatePointPoint}, #{coordinatePointType}, #{firstRegisteredDate}, #{lastModifiedDate}, #{sigungu.sigunguId} );
mapper.select: SELECT sd_id, sd_name FROM juso_sido ORDER BY sd_name
SELECT sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM juso_sigungu sgg JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE sgg.sd_id = #{sidoId} ORDER BY sgg.sgg_name

SELECT sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM juso_sigungu sgg JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE ST_Contains( sgg.sgg_border, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM juso_sigungu sgg JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE sgg.sgg_id = #{sigunguId}

SELECT COALESCE(i.image_count, 0) as image_count, COALESCE(a.album_count, 0) as album_count, COALESCE(s.sigungu_count, 0) as sigungu_count FROM (SELECT #{userId} as user_id) u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as image_count FROM image WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) i ON u.user_id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as album_count FROM album WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) a ON u.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.sgg_id) as sigungu_count FROM image i JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.user_id ) s ON u.user_id = s.user_id
